newsitem.title: CANADA: BC Tel sees wireless TV decision in March.
newsitem.headline: BC Tel sees wireless TV decision in March.

text.p: BC Telecom Inc said Thursday it expects to decide by late March whether to proceed with an effort to launch wireless digital television in British Columbia.

A BC Tel unit signed a letter of intent with a subsidiary of Simmonds Capital Ltd on a joint venture to explore opportunities in wireless digital television and high-speed Internet access using multichannel multipoint distribution.
A BC Tel spokeswoman said that over the next month the companies would come up with estimates of the cost of providing such services in British Columbia and "whether it is worth the investment."
